basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Founding Product Engineer · Full-Stack AI Products, Shipped and Operated · Founder · Private Market Investor
basics.summary: Founding engineer who ships and runs full-stack AI products end to end: UI, backend, LLM workflows, data, deployment and on-call. Founding AI Engineer (GTM) at LumApps, where I took multi-agent workflows from discovery to production on GCP with eval pipelines, tracing and cost-per-request instrumentation: 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast quarterly revenue. Founding engineer at Dronistics (500+ real deliveries on a Vue/Java/PostgreSQL stack built from scratch) and solo builder of SwissNRI and Proplab, document-heavy AI products taken zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Private market investor for 7+ years (SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Polymarket), so valuations, secondaries and scenario thinking are lived experience, not a domain I need explained.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI: ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, tools exposed over MCP servers, agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI so users see loading, progress and failures. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue.

Owned the product from technical discovery to production as the primary hands-on engineer: agent architecture, structured outputs, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, deployment and on-call. Report to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub and a freshness layer that flags stale facts, so wrong outputs can be traced to their source and corrected.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected and shipped Employee Referral System end to end (Java, Vue, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search) as Tech Lead reporting to the CIO, then ran it in production at 99.99% SLA. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions + OpenAI) built in 6 weeks, with validation checks on every output. 12K+ assets translated; product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting and recovery when things broke.

Product Owner and architect of the distributed templating engine: cut customer setup time 90%, powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Also owned architecture for Artifacts, Forms and Manager Hub.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy and engineering cultures that ship; mentored Opt Alpha on scaling algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped the autonomous drone delivery platform end to end (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL): UI, APIs, logistics optimization and flight control. 500+ real-world deliveries, 40% faster, 99.5% safety record.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline on AWS from scratch. Reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics; supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families. Document-grounded RAG assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions with citations back to the regulation; agents flag risk before users file, with guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction, running in production.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Document and image processing product for property teams: vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos into queryable records; LLM agents turn them into multilingual listings. One workflow from photo to published listing, full stack owned solo.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: PEX (Enzian Labs), Zürich, 100% on-site. Very early startup: software helping private-market investors understand company valuations and run portfolio scenarios; combines document processing, AI and financial models. Founding product engineer inheriting founder-built codebase; primary hands-on engineer across UI, backend, AI integrations, data flows, deployment. Own codebase, APIs, storage, background jobs, integrations, deployment, monitoring, recovery; keep infra and AI costs proportionate. Use AI coding tools with judgment; build reliable LLM workflows with structured outputs, evaluation, failure handling. Lightweight engineering discipline: backlog, definition of done, docs, surface trade-offs. Wants: shipped and maintained full-stack product, LLM integration with output checks, work in imperfect codebase, self-organizing, founding/early-startup/hands-on lead experience. Finance helpful not required. Possible future team lead. Apply with intro + 1 to 2 shipped product examples (what you built, how you used AI, what you owned in production).
_jobApplication.notes: User: private market investor 7+ years (SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Polymarket). LumApps title as Founding AI Engineer, GTM. Do not mention PulseView (not working). Second application to EnzianLabs (prior: CTO / Quant Engineer).
